title: Avoid manual focus useEffect in components nested inside other floating/dropdown elements
answers: Focus doesn't move into the modal/popover when opened from a dropdown menu item
ConfirmModal input or button never gets focused via keyboard navigation from a menu
Focus trap fails only when the dialog is triggered from inside another floating element
Why does focus jump back to the dropdown trigger instead of staying in the new modal
body:
Symptom: a ConfirmModal (or similar floating element) opened from a Dropdown/Menu item renders, but keyboard focus stays on the original trigger button instead of moving into the new element's input/button.
Root cause: a manual `useEffect` calling `.focus()` directly (previously in packages/grafana-ui/src/components/ConfirmModal/ConfirmContent.tsx) races against floating-ui's own microtask-queued focus restoration for the closing Dropdown's FloatingFocusManager. The effect's focus() call queues a *later* microtask than the dropdown's return-focus-to-trigger microtask, so the dropdown's microtask runs last and steals focus back.
Fix pattern: remove manual `.focus()` calls in useEffect and instead pass refs through to the outer floating component's `initialFocus` prop (see FloatingFocusManager's initialFocus, wired via packages/grafana-ui/src/components/ConfirmModal/ConfirmModal.tsx:ConfirmModal passing confirmButtonRef/confirmPromptRef into Modal's initialFocus) so floating-ui itself owns and sequences the focus transition.
Constraints: applies whenever a floating/modal component can be triggered from inside another floating element that manages its own focus-restore-on-close (Dropdown, Tooltip, Popover). Does not apply to top-level modals opened from plain DOM elements, where manual focus via useEffect/autoFocus is safe.
applies: grafana-ui floating/modal components (ConfirmModal, and similarly structured components) that can be opened from within a Dropdown/Menu or other FloatingFocusManager-wrapped trigger.
says: Focus doesn't move into the modal when opened from dropdown menu
Dialog input never receives focus via keyboard from a menu item
Focus trap fails only when opening inside another floating element
Why does focus jump back to dropdown instead of staying in modal?
search: Manual useEffect calls to .focus() in nested floating components race against floating-ui's focus-restoration microtasks, causing the parent dropdown/menu to steal focus back. Use the initialFocus prop on the outer floating component (ConfirmModal's initialFocus passed through FloatingFocusManager in packages/grafana-ui/src/components/ConfirmModal) to let floating-ui sequence focus transitions instead. Applies only to modal/floating components opened from within Dropdown/Menu/Popover elements with their own focus restoration; does not apply to top-level modals triggered from plain DOM. Remove manual .focus() calls from ConfirmContent.tsx and similar nested components and pass refs to the parent's initialFocus prop.
